title: festuca valesiaca f. hirsuta
intro: Festuca valesiaca f. hirsuta, commonly known as alpine fescue, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the grass family (Poaceae). This plant is valued for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Festuca valesiaca f. hirsuta include anti-diarrheal, anti-spasmodic, and expectorant effects, making it useful in treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
